prompt_prefix: gritty western illustration, Sergio Leone palette, dust and leather, desaturated warm tones, harsh sunlight, frontier realism, spaghetti western aesthetic
prompt_suffix: no text, no watermarks, weathered and authentic, cinematic western quality, dust in the air
negative_prompt: clean, modern, green lush, fantasy, sci-fi, anime, cartoon, bright saturated colors, rain, snow, ocean

mood_modifiers.tense: standoff composition, eyes narrowed against sun, hands near holsters, dust settling
mood_modifiers.joyful: rare saloon warmth, golden hour celebration, hard-won victory, campfire camaraderie
mood_modifiers.eerie: ghost town silence, tumbleweeds, abandoned mines, something wrong in the desert
mood_modifiers.epic: vast frontier scale, rider against mesa, manifest destiny grandeur, golden hour drama
mood_modifiers.peaceful: sunset on the range, horses grazing, quiet moment before the storm
mood_modifiers.melancholy: graves on hillside, abandoned homestead, end of an era, last of a kind
mood_modifiers.awe: monument valley grandeur, nature's cathedral, tiny humans in vast landscape
mood_modifiers.dread: vultures circling, approaching dust cloud, no way out, frontier justice coming

scene.wide: frontier vista, mesa and desert, big sky country, environmental western
scene.medium: main street showdown framing, buildings as walls, dust and tension
scene.close: weathered face, squinting eyes, sweat and dust, character study
scene.low_angle: hero or villain looming, sun behind, silhouette against sky
scene.overhead: canyon or gulch tactical view, ambush geography, trail visible
scene.default: classic western composition, foreground figure, vast background, golden light

portrait.default: weathered face portrait, hat shadow across eyes, dust on features, hard miles visible

location_card.default: frontier town establishing shot, main street, horses tied, promise of trouble

item.default: revolver or artifact on wood surface, worn leather, frontier craftsmanship

moment.default: gunfight frozen moment, dust kicked up, muzzle flash, decisive action
